contract_boundary: Disposable SQLite model with a caller-provided route and expected epoch. Begin an immediate transaction for the scoped key and serving epoch. Write outbox and key together. Return stale without prior job disclosure, conflict for current mutations and unavailable when the write cannot complete. No adapter is wired into the serving or operator pipeline.

additional: Expired replay with changed payload and true/false/absent.
Audit committed writes to both intake-key and outbox tables for no-effect paths.
Injected failure between outbox and key writes to check rollback.

review_limits: This tests only the standalone model against disposable data. It does not prove current serving behavior, distributed epoch coupling, active routing, late response validation or deployment.
Require later review for actual routing/admission integration, serving generation, isolated runtime and explicit release. Do not run live job submission or curation.
